$comment: Generated from packages/protocol/src by `pnpm --filter @sondine/protocol run gen`. Do not edit.
title: Sondine phone recording header
description: The JSON the iPhone app writes in a recording's comment tag, before its first sample (ADR 032).

recordingId.description: This file's id; the Mac's track run is `phone:<recordingId>`.

sessionId.description: The session the file belongs to: one tap on « Enregistrer ».

part.description: This file's place in its session, from 1.

startedWallMs.description: The phone's wall clock at the file's first sample.

utcOffsetMin.description: The phone's UTC offset then, in minutes.

deviceId.description: The app's random install id (not the phone's name).

PhoneRecordingHeader.description: The header of one file the iPhone app recorded, in its comment tag.

WallMs.description: Wall-clock milliseconds since the Unix epoch; display and calendar only.

PhoneInputKind.description: The kind of microphone iOS routed: the phone's own, a wired headset, a Bluetooth one, or another (USB, CarPlay…).

PhonePartEnd.description: Why the session's previous file ended: an interruption (a call, another app's microphone), or the 3 hour rotation.

PhoneAppVersion.description: The app's version and build, as `0.1.0 (12)`.
